data.key: Monk of the Four Winds ~ Aspect of the Oni
data.name: Aspect of the Oni
data.description: The monk's skin becomes pitch black, and his hair turns white, black, red, or violet. He can assume gaseous form (as the spell) as a standard action for 1 minute per day per monk level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. The oni is treacherous and deceitful, and it hungers for the pain and death of living creatures-a monk must be evil to take on the aspect of the oni.
